description: The line plot illustrates the performance change, measured by minimum Average Displacement Error (minADE₂₀), as a function of the ratio of the in-context pool size, with the x-axis labeled "Ratio" ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "minADE₂₀ (←)", represents the error metric and ranges from 0.55 to 0.75. Five different methods are compared: TrajICL (blue circles, solid line), Head Tuning (orange circles, solid line), FT (green circles, solid line), LoRA 16 (red circles, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple circles, solid line). The TrajICL line starts at a minADE₂₀ of approximately 0.61 and remains relatively flat, ending at 0.61. The Head Tuning line starts at 0.77 and shows a steady decline to 0.69. The FT line starts at 0.68 and decreases sharply to 0.55. The LoRA 16 line starts at 0.74 and decreases to 0.61. The LoRA 64 line starts at 0.73 and decreases to 0.61.
